title: THE ÆCLYPTIC: Seven Years Between Shadows
world_rules: Astronomical history distinct from invented eclipse biology
Rare Nexus Systems; most awakened have no System
Transmigration is an identity transition, not power level
Synesthesia describes private system presentation, not separate system
No automatic trauma or hazardous radiation benefit
Artifacts preserve provenance, capability, cost, limit, consequence
Public canon excludes private Dreamcorp personnel and operational configurations

episodes.logline: A voice appears in the only protagonist's waking interface during the second Great American Eclipse; witnesses report divergent experiences.
